blocks.text: Biosphere ecological organization ka sab se ooncha aur sab ko shamil karne wala level hai. Yeh duniya ke tamam biomes ka majmooa hai. Is se murad zameen ka har woh hissa hai jahan zindagi maujood hai: Arabian Sea ki sab se gehri khaiyon (trenches) se le kar Himalaya ki sab se oonchi chotiyon tak, balke hawa mein kai kilometre oopar tak.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Biosphere ko aksar "Global Ecosystem" (aalami ecosystem) kaha jata hai. Yeh zameen ke gird ek patla "ghilaf" (envelope) hai jahan lithosphere (khushki), hydrosphere (paani) aur atmosphere (hawa) mil kar zindagi ko sahara dete hain.

blocks.alt: Do qataron mein chhe jure hue hexagon, kitab ki tarah. Neeche wali qatar, baen se daen: 1. Species (aik Indus River dolphin), 2. Population (kai dolphins), 3. Community (talaab mein dolphins, machhliyan aur bagla). Oopar wali qatar, daen se baen: 4. Ecosystem (suraj, badal, pahar aur darya ki wadi), 5. Biome (Pakistan ka naqsha: Swat ka jangal, Thar ka registan, Indus), 6. Biosphere (zameen ka gola).
blocks.caption: Figure 25.1: Ecological tanzeem ke darje (kitab ki Figure 25.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Panels ki ibaratein kitab wali hain (English mein): SPECIES se BIOSPHERE tak. Teer neeche 1 se 2 se 3, phir 3 se oopar 4, phir oopar 4 se 5 se 6 tak jaate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tarah chhe hexagon do qataron mein hain: neeche 1 se 3 tak baen se daen, phir teer oopar 4 par, aur oopar 4 se 6 tak daen se baen. Is tarah tarteeb species (aik dolphin) se population (kai dolphins), community (kai qismein), ecosystem (jandar + be-jaan mahol), biome (aab-o-hawa wala bara ilaqa) aur biosphere (poori zameen ki zindagi) tak jati hai.

blocks.prompt: ‘Pakistan ke tamam Markhor’ species kehlayenge ya population?
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq poore Pakistan ke Markhoron ki baat species ki baat hai, jabke kisi ek ilaqe (jaise Chitral Gol National Park) ke Markhor ek population hain.

items: Tarteeb: species → population → community → ecosystem → biome → biosphere.
Species: aapas mein fertile bachche paida karne wale milte julte jandar (Indus River Dolphin). Population: ek ilaqe mein ek species (Chitral Gol ke Markhor).
Community: ek ilaqe ki tamam populations; ecosystem = community + be-jaan mahol (tawanai ek simt mein, nutrients chakkar mein).
Biome: khaas aab-o-hawa wala bara ilaqa (Murree/Swat ke conifer jangal, Thal/Thar registan); biosphere: zameen par zindagi wali har jagah.
